terminals.name: webui
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=. KRONOS_INFERENCE_BACKEND=local KRONOS_DEVICE=cpu && python webui/app.py

terminals.name: serverless-api
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=. KRONOS_DEVICE=cpu KRONOS_MODEL_ID=models/a_share_v1_beta/releases/beta_v1.2/best_model KRONOS_TOKENIZER_ID=models/a_share_v1_beta/releases/beta_v1.2/tokenizer && flask --app api.index run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
